comments.author: @doesntmatter879
comments.text:
"I can't remember Mom's laugh"..  My mom was always the one behind the camera..  She died this Christmas and now I'm left with two clips of her voice.. a video I found on Facebook that was buried and an old voicemail my brother saved.... 

And I realized, I'm always behind the camera too... Record yourself for your loved ones.. send videos of emails, put them in thumb drives, and print out pictures... 

I even bought one of those cards that let's you record a voice when my son turned 18... 

Cherish your memories.
